What is wrong, or what is missing. Present tense, about the tree as it is now.

## Evidence

The command that shows it, and its output. Run against the reference a reader
will have rather than against a working copy. Where there is no command, write
the observation as a claim and say that it is one.

```
```

## Done when

The condition that closes this, written so that somebody else can tell whether
it has been met without asking. Where the condition is a number, name the
command that produces it. Where it is a guard, the condition includes the proof
that the guard refuses the defect it names.

## Scope

The paths this is allowed to touch, where that is narrower than the repository.
Leave this out rather than writing "all".
